test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following features of the Indian Constitution is NOT borrowed from Australia?

options.text: Joint sitting of the two houses
Election of members of the Rajya Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**Election of members of the Rajya Sabha**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The Indian Constitution has borrowed several features from the **Australian Constitution**, but the system for the **election of members of the Rajya Sabha** is not one of them. The Rajya Sabha members are elected by the elected members of the State Legislative Assemblies through a system of proportional representation by means of a single transferable vote, which is not a feature of the Australian Constitution. 
• The **concept of the Concurrent List**, which specifies subjects on which both the Union and State Legislatures can legislate, is borrowed from the Australian Constitution. ***Hence, this statement is correct.*** 
• The provision for a **joint sitting of the two houses** of Parliament to resolve deadlocks between the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha is also inspired by the Australian parliamentary system. ***Hence, this statement is correct.***
